0022600215.text: The Sacramento Kings, 1-9 overall and 0-5 at home, host the Orlando Magic (2-7, 2-3 on the road) with the Kings on a three-game losing streak and the Magic on a four-game skid. Sacramento is without Ben Simmons (Achilles, surgery), Domantas Sabonis (knee, soreness), and Maxime Raynaud (knee, dislocated), while Orlando is missing Izaiyah Nelson (ankle, surgery), Jalen Suggs (knee), Jonathan Isaac (knee), Noah Penda (hamstring, strain), and Paolo Banchero (ankle, sprain), with Desmond Bane listed as day-to-day with an illness and a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet this season, and the Kings lost both games to the Magic in 2025-26, most recently 121-117 in Orlando on March 26, 2026.
